2920007.name: Lv. 20 ETC Bypass Key
2920007.desc: Drag the #cBypass Key# into an equip window slot (#chotkey E#) to equip ETC equipment that is for #cup to 20 levels# above yours for #c3 days#. \n#cYou cannot stack and use Bypass Keys of other levels.# Characters with the #cEmpress's Might# skill cannot use Bypass Keys. \n#c Bypass Key Available Slots:# Medals, Badges, Dragons, Mechanic Equipment

2671173.name: 점핑 슬라임 나무액자
2671173.desc: 통통 튀어다니는 슬라임의 모습이 그려진 액자. 점프 능력으로는 주황버섯과 슬라임을 따라올 자가 없다.

2671178.name: 앤티크 석고액자 - 메르세데스
2671178.desc: 엘프 여왕 메르세데스의 초상화가 그려진 액자. 여왕님답게 우아하고 기품이 넘친다.

2671175.name: 오래된 목재 창문
2671175.desc: 세월의 흐름이 느껴지는 목재 창문. 바람이 불 때마다 삐그덕 거리는 소리가 난다. 그래도 귀신은 아니니 걱정하지 말자.

2672237.name: 오래된 원목 싱글침대
2672237.desc: 세월의 흐름이 느껴지는 원목 침대. 몸을 뒤척일 때마다 삐그덕 소리가 난다. 그래도 무너지진 않으니 걱정하지 말자.

2672242.name: 단풍나무 분재
2672242.desc: 수많은 인고의 시간 끝에 자라난 한 단풍나무의 분재. 인내의 숲 속 두 뿌리 홍삼을 손에 넣은 자만이 이 분재를 가꿀 자격을 가진다.

2672230.name: 주황버섯 인형
2672230.desc: 평범한 주황버섯 인형. 말랑말랑한 재질로, 와락 끌어안고 있으면 마음이 편안해진다.

2672231.name: 소형 해바라기 화분
2672231.desc: 소형 해바라기 화분. 화분도 소형이고 해바라기도 소형이다. 해바라기의 샛노란 색이 집을 화사하게 만들어주는 것 같다.

2672236.name: Sleepywood Sauna Bathtub
2672236.desc: A replica of the bathtub at the Sleepywood Hotel Sauna. It's a little piece of luxury that can come home with you when you have to leave the sauna.

2672243.name: 혼테일 분수
2672243.desc: 사악한 삼두룡 혼테일의 외형을 딴 분수. 압도적으로 강한 용사와 마주쳐 순식간에 굳어버린 것 같기도 하다.

2672234.name: 월넛 데이베드
2672234.desc: 메이플 월드의 험난한 지형을 모두 등반한 당신이여! 이제는 쉬어라. 끝없는 탐구심과 인내심, 끈기를 모두 갖춘 당신은 충분한 자격을 갖추었다!

2672240.name: 킹사이즈 고급가죽 침대
2672240.desc: 상점에서 100억 메소 정도를 거뜬히 Flex 하는 사람이라면, 분명 이런 고급 가죽 침대에서 잠이 들 거다. 묘하게 메소의 향이 나는 듯 하다.

2671188.name: 크리스탈 샹들리에
2671188.desc: 빛을 받아 반짝거리는 모습이 아름다운 크리스탈 샹들리에다.

2671180.name: 자연주의 나무 시계
2671180.desc: 100% 나무로 만든 시계. 배터리는 나무가 아니냐는 딴지는 걸지 말자.

2671170.name: 살랑살랑 레이스 커튼 창문
2671170.desc: 분홍색 레이스 커튼이 달린 창문. 바람이 들어와 살랑살랑 거리는 모습이 보기 좋다.

2671171.name: 점핑 주황버섯 나무액자
2671171.desc: 통통 튀어다니는 주황버섯의 모습이 그려진 액자. 독보적인 점프 능력은 주황버섯을 따라올 자가 없다.

2671172.name: 점핑 리본돼지 나무액자
2671172.desc: 뛰어다니고 튀어다니기도 하는 리본돼지의 모습이 그려진 액자. 리본돼지의 질주 본능은 그칠 줄 모른다.

2671174.name: 원목 주방 선반
2671174.desc: 나무로 만든 주방 선반. 여러 주방 도구를 간편히 보관할 수 있다.

2671181.name: 마크라메 행잉 플렌츠
2671181.desc: 벽에 거는 식물 장식. 약초로 꼭 약만 만드는 것이 아니다. 미적 감각만 있다면, 그 무엇이든 예술 작품이 될 수 있다.

2671182.name: 아치형 창문
2671182.desc: 위가 둥근 아치형 창문. 실내에서 아이템을 분해하면 먼지가 많이 날리니 창문을 항상 열도록 하자. 언제나 환기는 중요하다.

2671183.name: 앤티크 석고액자 - 시그너스
2671183.desc: 여제 시그너스의 초상화가 그려진 액자. 친절하고 온화해 보이는 그녀이지만, 속으론 많은 걱정거리를 안고 있을 것이다. 잘못된 길을 걸으면 안 될 텐데.

2671177.name: 메이플 월드맵
2671177.desc: 메이플 월드 전역이 상세히 그려진 지도. 분명 이 지도를 만들기 위해 누군가는 직접 모든 곳을 발로 뛰어다녔을 것이다.

2671184.name: 마크라메 커튼 창문
2671184.desc: 분위기 있는 마크라메 커튼이 달린 창문. 은은하게 새어 들어오는 태양 빛이 제법 아름답다.

2671176.name: 페리온 태양 패브릭 포스터
2671176.desc: 페리온의 태양 장식이 그려진 패브릭 포스터. 어디까지나 기념품이니 이걸 두르고 페리온의 모래 황야를 걸어다닐 생각은 말자. 입에 모래 들어온다.

2671185.name: 행잉 플랜츠
2671185.desc: 벽에 거는 식물 장식. 누군가에겐 이 식물들도 소중한 전리품이나 다름 없겠지.

2671186.name: 파풀라투스 벽시계
2671186.desc: 파풀라투스가 타고 있는 시계를 꼭 빼닮은 벽시계. 그러나 혹시 모른다. 꽤나 정교한 것이, 파풀라투스의 시계가 맞는 걸지도?

2671187.name: 포스터 - 드래곤 마스터
2671187.desc: 드래곤 마스터 에반의 모습이 그려진 포스터. 농부의 아들이 영웅의 후계자가 될 줄 누가 알았을까? 운명이란 건 정말 대단하다.

2671189.name: 포스터 - 태초의 버섯
2671189.desc: 버섯이 그려진 포스터. 머쉬킹의 말에 따르면 태초의 버섯이라고 하는데, 진위 여부는 알 수 없다. 그림이지만 점프에 대한 열망이 느껴진다.

2671190.name: 포스터 - 꿈을 조종하는 자
2671190.desc: 군단장 루시드의 모습이 그려진 포스터. 머리맡에 붙이고 자면 왠지 모르게 악몽을 꿀 것 같다.

2671191.name: 포스터 - 오, 나의 여제님!
2671191.desc: 각성한 시그너스 여제의 모습이 그려진 포스터. 세계의 운명을 짊어진 그 고난과 걱정은 상상할 수 없을 만큼 괴로울 것이다. 그러다 잘못된 길로 나가면 안 될 텐데.

2671192.name: 포스터 - 아르카나의 정령들
2671192.desc: 아르카나의 귀여운 정령들이 그려진 포스터. 아르카나의 아름다운 풍경도 엿볼 수 있다.

2671194.name: 포스터 - 엘프의 여왕
2671194.desc: 엘프의 여왕 메르세데스가 그려진 포스터. 군단장 루시드가 사모한 존재답게, 멋있고 우아한 자태를 뽐내고 있다.

2671195.name: 포스터 - 우리는 시그너스 기사단
2671195.desc: 시그너스 기사단이 그려진 포스터. 여제를 수호하는 기사들답게 당당하고 강인한 모습을 엿볼 수 있다.

2671197.name: 천연 라탄 접시 장식
2671197.desc: 페리온의 이얀이 한땀한땀 만든 라탄 접시. 다행히도 돼지와 함께 춤을이 장난을 쳐 두진 않았다.

2671198.name: 반반의 태엽시계
2671198.desc: 시간술사 반반의 태엽시계. 시간술사도 시계는 필요하다. 다행히 시간이 갑자기 빨라지거나 거꾸로 흘러가지는 않는다.

2671199.name: 시그너스 인형선반
2671199.desc: 타락한 시그너스와 신수 인형이 올라간 선반. 조작된 미래의 모습이었지만, 항상 조심하는 게 좋을 것 같다.

2671200.name: 칼로스 실링 팬
2671200.desc: 칼로스 드론을 닮은 실링 팬. 다행히 빔은 쏘지 않는다. 만약 빨간색으로 변하면 에너지파를 쏴보자.

2671201.name: 듄켈의 투구 장식
2671201.desc: 친위대장 듄켈의 투구 장식. 투구를 쓰려는 자는 그 무게를 견뎌야 하지만, 장식이기에 그렇게 무겁지 않다.

2671202.name: 신성검 벽걸이 장식
2671202.desc: 신성검 아소르의 외형을 본뜬 벽걸이 장식. 제법 섬세한 디테일 덕에, 선택받지 않은 자도 검에게 선택받은 기분이 들게 한다.

2671218.name: 류드의 검
2671218.desc: 한 용병이 쓰던 검. 검의 소유자는 그가 사용하던 특이한 검술을 구사할 수 있게 된다고 한다.

2672245.name: 힐라 오벨리스크 스탠드
2672245.desc: 힐라의 오벨리스크를 본뜬 스탠드. 어디서 언데드 몬스터가 나타날 것만 같다.

2672222.name: 달콤한 휴식 데이베드
2672222.desc: 일과 중 달콤한 휴식을 맞이할 수 있게 해 주는 데이베드. 하지만 너무 깊은 잠을 청하지는 말자. 밤에 못 잔다.

2672227.name: 패브릭 크림 코너소파
2672227.desc: 산뜻한 크림색의 코너소파. 때가 타면 보기 싫어지니 청소를 깔끔히 하도록 하자.

2672228.name: 패브릭 크림 소파
2672228.desc: 산뜻한 크림색의 소파. 때가 타면 보기 싫어지니 청소를 깔끔히 하도록 하자.

2672229.name: 빨간 버섯 스툴
2672229.desc: 버섯 모양 스툴. 점프대가 아니니, 있는 힘껏 몸으로 푹 눌러앉았다가 실망하지 말자.

2672223.name: 원목 행거
2672223.desc: 나무로 만든 평범한 행거. 의자에 대충 널어놓지 말고, 행거에 걸어 옷이 구겨지지 않도록 하자.

2672224.name: 원목 아일랜드 식탁
2672224.desc: 나무로 만든 평범한 아일랜드 식탁. 음식을 먹고 흘리면 재빠르게 닦도록 하자.

2672225.name: 가스오븐레인지
2672225.desc: 가스레인지와 오븐이 합쳐진 일체형 조리 기구. 자취인들의 필수 아이템이다.

2672238.name: 소형 화분
2672238.desc: 아담한 소형 화분. 크기는 작지만 집 전체를 향긋한 향기로 채울 수 있다.

2672246.name: 로코코 천연 가죽침대
2672246.desc: 섬세한 감성을 가진 사람들을 위한 가죽침대. 편안하고 안락하다. 누워있기만 해도 감성이 충만해진다.

2672247.name: 로코코 1인용 소가죽 소파
2672247.desc: 반짝반짝 빛나는 스타를 위한 소가죽 소파. 단 한 명의 스타를 위한 고급 의자라 특별함이 느껴진다.

2672248.name: 로코코 소가죽 코너소파
2672248.desc: 수많은 스타들을 탄생시킨 전설적인 엔터테이너가 즐겨 썼다던 코너소파. 역시 소가죽이라 그런지 느낌이 다르다.

2672249.name: 오크나무 테이블
2672249.desc: 사서 위즈가 좋아하는 오크나무로 제작한 테이블. 은은한 피톤치드가 편안함을 가져다준다.

2672250.name: 앤티크 대리석 벽난로
2672250.desc: 불꽃늑대처럼 뜨겁게 타오르는 불꽃을 품은 벽난로. 영원히 꺼지지 않을 것만 같다.

2672251.name: 오크나무 책상
2672251.desc: 사서 위즈가 좋아하는 오크나무로 제작한 책상. 은은한 피톤치드가 집중력을 향상시켜 준다. 하지만 그래도 일은 하기 싫은걸.

2672252.name: 오크나무 3단 책장
2672252.desc: 탄소 연대 측정 결과 엄청난 세월을 살아온 것 같다는 책장. 책장에게 나이를 물어봐도 대답을 해 주진 않으니 믿거나 말거나다.

2672239.name: 산호 어항
2672239.desc: 아쿠아로드 곳곳에 있는 산호를 모아 어항으로 만들었다. 물갈이를 하기 위해 아쿠아리움까지 가야 하는 작은 단점이 있다.

2672254.name: 에스닉 해먹 침대
2672254.desc: 전설적인 요리사가 엄청난 수의 대량 주문을 성공적으로 마치고 편히 잠들었다는 침대.

2672255.name: 에스닉 패턴 패브릭 소파
2672255.desc: 전설적인 요리사가 엄청난 수의 대량 주문을 성공적으로 마치고 편히 쉬었다는 소파.

2672256.name: 천연 라탄 체어
2672256.desc: 전 세계에 명성을 드높인 자만이 앉을 수 있다는 의자. 고급스런 라탄의 질감이 편안하고 안락한 느낌을 준다.

2672257.name: 테이블 가든
2672257.desc: 약초들을 수없이 캐어 이제 테이블 데코까지 하게 되었다. 몸이 건강해지는 향기가 난다.

2672241.name: Sleepywood Sink
2672241.desc: A replica of the sink at the Sleepywood Hotel. It's a little piece of luxury that can come home with you when you have to leave the sauna.

2672258.name: 페리온 토템 장식
2672258.desc: 페리온의 명물인 토템 장식. 왜인지는 모르지만, 눈빛이 우리를 지켜주겠다는 게 아니라, 살려달라고 말하는 듯하다.

2672259.name: 발록의 뿔 의자
2672259.desc: 마왕 발록의 뿔이 장식된 의자. 삐딱한 자세로 앉아 있으면 정말 메이플 월드의 마왕이 된 느낌이 든다.

2672260.name: 자쿰의 손 테이블
2672260.desc: 당장이라도 무언가를 움켜쥘 것만 같은 자쿰의 손 테이블. 하지만 걱정하지 말자. 움직이지는 않는다. 아마도.

2672261.name: 매그너스의 뿔 의자
2672261.desc: 한 배신자가 떠오르는 디자인의 의자. 여기 앉는다고 운석을 막 뿌리거나 하지는 못한다. 하지만 배신자의 왕 기분은 낼 수 있다.

2672262.name: 카웅 청소기
2672262.desc: 외계의 기술력으로 만들었다는 카웅 청소기. 그런 것 치곤 사람의 말을 잘 알아듣는다. 가끔 안에 누군가가 타고 있는 듯한 착각을 일으키기도 한다.

2672263.name: 피에르 우산꽂이
2672263.desc: 피에르의 파티장에 놓여있던 우산꽂이. 우산이라는 것이 늘 그렇듯 주인이 있다가도 없다. 피에르는 세 모습이 한 몸이니 있다가도 없는 게 맞긴 하다.

2672264.name: 블러디퀸 화장대
2672264.desc: 루타비스의 블러디퀸이 사용했다는 화장대. 거울 속을 들여다보면 거울 속의 누군가가 나를 들여다보는 꺼림직한 기분이 든다.

2672265.name: 벨룸 용암욕조
2672265.desc: 루타비스의 벨룸이 연상되는 디자인의 욕조. 용암처럼 보이는 불에 겁먹지 말자. 겉모습만 그렇다.

2672226.name: 헤네시스 들꽃 화분
2672226.desc: 헤네시스의 이름 없는 들꽃이 심어진 화분이다. 들꽃이 화분이 되어 만난 것도 인연이니, 정성스럽게 돌보아 주도록 하자.

2672266.name: 버섯 플로어 스탠드
2672266.desc: 집보다는 스탠드가 되고자 한 굳센 의지가 이 주황버섯을 스탠드로 만들었다. 영롱하게 빛나는 이 버섯을 축하해 주자.

2672267.name: 아쿠아리움 산호 스탠드
2672267.desc: 아쿠아리움 동물원의 산호 조명과 같은 산호 스탠드. 뮤즈가 직접 만든 축소판 스탠드다.

2672235.name: 미니 철제 금고
2672235.desc:
소중하거나 값비싼 물건을 보관할 수 있는 금고. 튼튼해서 잘 망가지지도 않는다. 그러니 웬만하면 비밀번호를 잊어버리지 말자.

#c배치된 가구를 클릭하여
창고를 이용할 수 있습니다.

2672232.name: 1인용 패브릭 소파
2672232.desc: 평범한 1인용 소파. 때로는 거만한 사장님 자세로 앉아 휴식을 취해보자. 이유 없이 자신감이 차오른다.

2672233.name: 기울어진 원형 테이블
2672233.desc: 살짝 삐그덕거리는 원형 테이블. 수평이 맞지는 않지만, 그 덕에 액체를 올려 두면 소소한 스릴을 느낄 수 있다.

2672269.name: 얼어붙은 사자상
2672269.desc: 사자 왕의 조각상. 마음뿐만 아니라 겉모습까지 얼어붙어 버렸다. 발치의 장미는 왜인지 모르게 슬퍼하는 것 같다.

2672270.name: 오르카 토끼 인형 쿠션
2672270.desc: 거대한 토끼 인형 쿠션. 양옆에는 스우와 오르카 쿠션도 함께 있다. 이 쌍둥이는 어딜 가든 항상 함께라더니, 여기서까지 같이 있다.

2672271.name: 아카이럼 석상
2672271.desc: 아카이럼의 상징인 뱀 석상. 날카로운 뱀 눈초리로 날 노려보고 있다. 다행히 이계의 사제는 소환되지 않는다. 하지만 혹시 모르니 잘 관리하도록 하자.

2672272.name: 핑크빈 소파
2672272.desc: 핑크빈을 잘 아는 자만이 앉을 수 있다는 전설의 분홍 콩 의자. 핑크빈의 배만큼이나 푹신푹신하다.

2672273.name: 루시드 침대
2672273.desc: 군단장 루시드가 잠을 청한다는 침대. 이게 여기 있으면 루시드는 대체 어디서 자는 거지?

2672274.name: 윌의 거미줄 해먹의자
2672274.desc: 윌의 거미줄로 만든 해먹 의자. 닿아도 스킬봉인이 걸리진 않으니 마음껏 쉬도록 하자.

2672275.name: 데미안의 검
2672275.desc: 군단장 데미안의 파멸의 검. 가까이 다가가면 알 수 없는 속삭임이 들린다. 홀리지 않도록 조심하자.

2672276.name: 가디언 엔젤 슬라임 분수
2672276.desc: 가디언 엔젤 슬라임의 모습을 딴 분수. 어떤 원리인지는 모르지만, 라무라무의 온천수가 흘러나온다. 역시 귀엽다.

2672277.name: 더스크 암흑 빈백
2672277.desc: 거대 괴수 더스크의 환각을 빼닮은 빈백. 닿아도 상태 이상에 걸리지 않으니 마음껏 기대도록 하자.

2672278.name: 영혼이 타오르는 양초
2672278.desc: 욕망의 제단에 놓인 영혼이 타오르는 양초. 꺼지지 않도록 조심스럽게 대하자.

2672279.name: 검은 마법사의 거울
2672279.desc: 검붉은 오라를 품기는 검은 마법사의 거울. 그는 여기서 무엇을 보았던 것일까?

2672268.name: 마네킹
2672268.desc: 마음대로 꾸밀 수 있는 마네킹이다. 개성을 살려 멋있게 꾸밀 수 있다.
2672268.desc_leftalign: #c배치된 가구를 클릭 후 슬롯에 치장 아이템을 드래그하여 마네킹을 장식할 수 있습니다.\n\n같은 종류의 마네킹 가구는 최대 3개까지만 배치할 수 있습니다.

2672280.name: 나무 진열장
2672280.desc: 나무로 된 진열장. 보여주고 싶은 아이템들을 진열해 둘 수 있다.
2672280.desc_leftalign: #c배치된 가구를 클릭 후 슬롯에 아이템을 드래그하여 아이템을 전시할 수 있습니다.\n\n같은 종류의 진열장 가구는 1개만 배치할 수 있습니다.

2671204.name: 나무 벽걸이 선반
2671204.desc: 나무로 된 벽걸이 선반. 보여주고 싶은 아이템들을 진열해 둘 수 있다.
2671204.desc_leftalign: #c배치된 가구를 클릭 후 슬롯에 아이템을 드래그하여 아이템을 전시할 수 있습니다.\n\n같은 종류의 진열장 가구는 1개만 배치할 수 있습니다.

2672281.name: Ribbon Piggy Bank
2672281.desc: Contains pocket change gathered over untold hours of hunting. You've collected a whole 10 billion!\n\n#cPlace and click to access the Storage Room.

2672283.name: Ritzy Mannequin
2672283.desc: A ritzy mannequin with an even fancier platform. Style it to your liking.
2672283.desc_leftalign: #cClick the placed mannequin, then drag a Decoration item into a slot to display it.\n\nCan only place 3 of each type of mannequin.

2672282.name: Golden Display Case
2672282.desc: A display case for a star who shines brighter than all others. Display your items with pride.
2672282.desc_leftalign: #cPlace and click, then drag an item into a slot to display it.\n\nCan only place 1 of each type of display case.

2671203.name: 황금 벽걸이 선반
2671203.desc: 스타들도 빛나기 위한 노력을 한다. 노력의 결과물을 벽걸이 선반에 전시해 보자.
2671203.desc_leftalign: #c배치된 가구를 클릭 후 슬롯에 아이템을 드래그하여 아이템을 전시할 수 있습니다.\n\n같은 종류의 진열장 가구는 1개만 배치할 수 있습니다.

2672284.name: Pitched Display Case
2672284.desc: Perfect for displaying the Pitched Boss set.
2672284.desc_leftalign: #cPlace and click, then drag an item into a slot to display it.\n\nCan only place 1 of each type of display case.

2672286.name: Potion Station
2672286.desc: Truly, you can never have too many potions.\n\n#cPlace and click to access the General Store.

2672285.name: Henesys Stall
2672285.desc: A kiosk you can buy from. Don't forget to get your seller's permit from Chief Stan.\n\n#cPlace and click to access the General Store.

2672287.name: Mushroom Refrigerator
2672287.desc: A refrigerator modeled after an Orange Mushroom. Not a refrigerator meant for cooling mushrooms or a refrigerator made out of mushroom, in case you were confused.\n\n#cPlace and click to access the General Store.

2672220.name: 원카드 미니게임 부스
2672220.desc: 메이플 월드의 용사들 사이에서 인기 있는 게임 중 하나인\n#c메이플 원카드#를 드디어 집에서 만나볼 수 있게 되었다!
2672220.desc_leftalign: #c메이플 홈 주인은 배치된 가구를 클릭하여 게임을 생성 및 시작할 수 있습니다.\n\n메이플 홈에 방문한 손님은 배치된 가구를 클릭하여 게임에 참여할 수 있습니다.

2672288.name: Slime Storage
2672288.desc: Contains pocket change gathered over untold hours of hunting. You've collected a whole 100 million!\n\n#cPlace and click to access the Storage Room.

2672289.name: Purple Safe
2672289.desc: Contains pocket change gathered over untold hours of hunting. You've collected a whole 100 billion!\n\n#cPlace and click to access the Storage Room.

2672300.name: Comfy Teddy Bear
2672300.desc: A huge teddy bear that's always ready to welcome you home with a big hug after a hard day.

2672301.name: Sweet Three-Tier Cake
2672301.desc: A beautiful cake made with great care. Its three layers represent joy, love, and hope.

2672302.name: Jumbo Junior Yeti Doll
2672302.desc: It's a little big for a for something called a 'Jr.' Yeti, but who cares, it's cute.

2676000.name: Dorm Window
2676000.desc: An ordinary window adorned with a cute Rock Spirit decoration. Be careful not to knock it off when opening the window.

2676001.name: Dorm Calendar
2676001.desc: A study plan is written on it. Will this plan be followed? Absolutely not. But hey, it's the thought that counts.

2676002.name: Jacket Hook
2676002.desc: A whole hook just for your jacket? That's some dedication.

2676003.name: Dorm Wall Display Case
2676003.desc: A storage unit akin to a pea pod with a Pink Bean squeezed into the bottom cubby.

2676004.name: Lecture Hall Window
2676004.desc: An ordinary window. Reminder: Do not use this as an escape hatch from a boring class--unless you're on the first floor.

2676005.name: Lecture Hall Chalkboard
2676005.desc: An ordinary chalkboard. The second your attention strays from it, it will be filled with formulas beyond your comprehension.

2676006.name: Lecture Hall Full Bulletin Board
2676006.desc: A bulletin board filled with helpful information about Maple University.

2676007.name: Lecture Hall Sparse Bulletin Board
2676007.desc: A bulletin board slightly less filled with helpful information about Maple University.

2676008.name: Silver Dimensional Power Plaque
2676008.desc: An award given to those who displayed great feats in climbing the Dimensional Tower. Even if you've fallen behind, your endurance will shine through.

2676009.name: Gold Dimensional Power Plaque
2676009.desc: An award given to those who displayed great feats in climbing the Dimensional Tower. Hard work is good as gold.

2676010.name: Diamond Dimensional Power Plaque
2676010.desc: An award given to those who displayed great feats in climbing the Dimensional Tower. It sparkles almost as much as you.

2676011.name: Maple U Pink Bean Tapestry
2676011.desc: A reproduction of the tapestries hung around campus. Unfortunately, you can't hang it from a balloon.

2676013.name: Maple U Stringed Pennants
2676013.desc: Several pendants strung together, featuring iconic monsters.

2676014.name: Teddy Window
2676014.desc: A window decorated with Pink Teddy's giant yellow bow.

2676015.name: Sovereign's Arms
2676015.desc: An award given to the ultimate sovereign. The hammers come off in case you want to have an impromptu match.

2676016.name: Lucid's Dreamcatcher
2676016.desc: A charm that Lucid made to ward off nightmares. Supposedly, if you hang it over your bed, no bad dreams can trouble your sleep.

2677000.name: Dorm Desk
2677000.desc: A small desk that magically sidetracks you from homework to anything else.

2677001.name: Dorm Bed
2677001.desc: A bed with the miraculous ability to lull you to sleep no matter how much homework you still haven't gotten done.

2677002.name: Potted Bloom
2677002.desc: It's a flower in a pot. A potted flower. A potted bloom, even.

2677003.name: Potted Sprout
2677003.desc: Somehow it's always looked like a sprout. Will it ever grow up?

2677004.name: Dorm Bedside Table
2677004.desc: The perfect place to put an alarm clock that you'll snooze every five minutes for hours on end.

2677005.name: Dorm Bookcase
2677005.desc: Full of books you'll definitely get around to reading, for sure.

2677006.name: Dorm Coat Tree
2677006.desc: Despite being purpose-made to hold coats, it often loses out to whatever chair is nearest the door.

2677007.name: Lecture Hall Seat
2677007.desc: It's a chair and a desk. Yet, it fails at being particularly good at either function.

2677008.name: Lecture Hall Podium
2677008.desc: One can hope it was shoddily made so it can collapse and end the lecture early.

2677010.name: Well-Loved Cat Tower
2677010.desc: Where cats hang out when they're tired of the cardboard box.

2677012.name: Textbook Stack
2677012.desc: A bunch of books about the science of jumping. How are there so many words to explain jumping?

2677013.name: University Lockers
2677013.desc: Lockers that open via a student ID card. Back in the day, they had passcodes like 0000 or 1234. Don't follow their example; those are horrible passwords.

2677014.name: Mini Slime Recycling Bin
2677014.desc: If you stare long enough, it seems to move around somehow. Don't worry, it's not real though. But it will eat you if you don't separate your recyclables. Don't test it.

2677015.name: Maple Leaf Mood Lamp
2677015.desc: The maple leaf (definitely not a star) emits a comforting golden glow.

2677016.name: Monster Translator
2677016.desc: Supposedly monsters gather around to swap info on their favorite foods.

2677017.name: The Thinking Yeti
2677017.desc: It's thinking pretty hard there, but is it actually making any progress?

2677018.name: Comfy Yut Sofa
2677018.desc: A supremely plush sofa awarded to masters of the Game of Yut. Don't be afraid to take your bad-roll induced anger on it. It can take it.

2677019.name: Pink Bean Racekart Bed
2677019.desc: When you've got to feel the thrill of the road, but also need your eight hours.

2677020.name: Legendary Holographic Throne
2677020.desc: The real legend has returned! The legendary throne that only the legend of legends can sit in, legendarily.

2638063.desc: Condensed remnants of distorted sin that remained after #cLimbo# disappeared. Collect #c10# and #cdouble-click# to obtain one #cpair of Shoes, pair of Gloves, or Cape# from the #cEternal# set.
2638063.name: Distorted Ambition

2638064.desc: An armor box imbued with #cKalos the Guardian's determination#.\n#cDouble-click# to obtain one #cHat, Top, Bottom, or Shoulder Accessory# from the #cEternal# set.
2638064.name: Divine Eternal Armor Box

2638065.desc: An armor box that still contains #cfaint traces of ferocious beasts#.\n#cDouble-click# to obtain one #cHat, Top, Bottom, or Shoulder Accessory# from the #cEternal# set.
2638065.name: Ferocious Beast Eternal Armor Box

2638066.desc: An armor box overflowing with #cdistorted sin#.\n#cDouble-click# to obtain one #cpair of Shoes, pair of Gloves, or Cape# from the #cEternal# set.
2638066.name: Eternal Armor of Desire Box

2638067.desc: An armor box imbued with #cKalos the Guardian's determination#.\n#cDouble-click# to obtain one #cHat, Top, Bottom, or Shoulder Accessory# from the #cEternal# set for your job.
2638067.name: Divine Eternal Armor Box

2638068.desc: An armor box that still contains #cfaint traces of ferocious beasts#.\n#cDouble-click# to obtain one #cHat, Top, Bottom, or Shoulder Accessory# from the #cEternal# set for your job.
2638068.name: Ferocious Beast Eternal Armor Box

2638069.desc: An armor box overflowing with #cdistorted sin#.\n#cDouble-click# to obtain one #cpair of Shoes, pair of Gloves, or Cape# from the #cEternal# set for your job.
2638069.name: Eternal Armor of Desire Box

2638071.desc: #cDouble-click# to obtain the #cShadow of the Source Effect#.

2638073.desc: #cDouble-click# to obtain a #cLabel Ring of the Source#.

2638074.name: Chat Ring of the Source Coupon
2638074.desc: #cDouble-click# to obtain a #cChat Ring of the Source#.

2670049.name: Dusk Metal Roof
2670049.desc: It's a roof that resembles the light of dusk, which is cold and blue. It wouldn't be strange at all if a ghost were to appear sometime.

2670050.name: Overgrown Pumpkin Patch Metal Roof
2670050.desc: One spooky moonlit night, I was walking through a lush pumpkin field. Suddenly, I saw a bright yellow eye glowing in the middle of the field! Then, pumpkin monsters arose and started to attack me...' \r\nIt's the perfect roof for turning off the lights, sitting around, and telling scary stories.

2670051.name: Dark Night Metal Roof
2670051.desc: Dark red, pointed iron decorations, and spider webs that have been untouched by humans for a long time. Perfect for a Halloween night.

2670052.name: Burgundy Neon Party Roof
2670052.desc: The colorful and charming neon roof will give you a night filled with passion and energy.

2670053.name: Violet Neon Party Roof
2670053.desc: A roof with a deep color that is suitable for an elegant party. The mysteriousness is a bonus.

2670054.name: Arcadia Neon Party Roof
2670054.desc: The soothing turquoise color of the glowing neon lights gives off a cozy and comfortable feeling.

2670055.name: No Roof Decoration
2670055.desc: We can go ahead and make the roof a little more special!

2670056.name: Swinging Ghost And Bat
2670056.desc: A ghost and bat decoration bring a sense of spooky fun.

2670057.name: Witch In Moonlight
2670057.desc: The silhouette of a witch on a broomstick flying across the moon is the iconic symbol of Halloween, right?

2670058.name: Dark Wooden Tile
2670058.desc: These antique wooden tiles evoke a warm sense of familiarity.

2670059.name: Mossy Clay Brick Exterior Wall
2670059.desc: A clay brick wall that retains its stylishness without losing its value over the years. It's perfect for completing a historic Halloween mansion.

2670060.name: Dark Log Exterior Wall
2670060.desc: The wooden log walls look just like a mountain cabin nestled deep in the forest.

2670061.name: Gray Stucco Exterior Wall
2670061.desc: This dark gray wall is perfect for creating a spooky Halloween vibe! It will match any roof or window.

2670062.name: Modern Marble Wall
2670062.desc: A smooth and simple marble wall completes the modern home. It will last for a long time due to its excellent durability.

2670063.name: Terracotta Wall
2670063.desc: A wall made with clay and baked to give it warmth and gentleness. It has a simple yet elegant look.

2670064.name: Classic Silk Wallpaper
2670064.desc: A classic silk wallpaper never goes out of style. It will class up your home for years to come.

2670065.name: Dusk Metal Window
2670065.desc: This window brings a bright and warm energy throughout the night to illuminate its surroundings.

2670066.name: Overgrown Pumpkin Patch Metal Window
2670066.desc: A pumpkin placed casually on the side of the window will drive away evil spirits!

2670067.name: Dark Night Metal Window
2670067.desc: Visiting guests might be startled! The dark red roof makes the iron decorations look more pointed and sharp.

2670068.name: Dancing Burgundy Neon Window
2670068.desc: Dancing skulls and smiling pumpkins will welcome your guests.

2670069.name: Dancing Violet Neon Window
2670069.desc: The light might be bright, but the mood it sets will be mysterious.

2670070.name: Dancing Arcadia Neon Window
2670070.desc: It feels like if I open the door, there will be an another world waiting for me.

2670071.name: Glulam Tile
2670071.desc: Trees of various colors are connected together, giving off a rhythmic vitality to a house that might otherwise be dull.

2670072.name: Clay Brick Tile
2670072.desc: Heavy clay brick with a strong sense of stability. Wood accents are added, creating a comfortable atmosphere.

2671055.name: Halloween Party Garland
2671055.desc: A garland is essential for any home party! Filling the empty walls with colorful garlands will bring you joy just by looking at it. You can change the atmosphere of your house by hanging multiple garlands in layers or adding small lights to them.

2671056.name: Halloween Mini Lights
2671056.desc: These shiny little light bulbs are a party staple! They give off warm and pleasant colors throughout the night.

2671057.name: Awakened Jiangshi CD Player
2671057.desc: If you need more stimulation in your boring daily life, how about some eerie music? A shiver will run down your spine!

2671058.name: Antique Candle Holder
2671058.desc: Create a soft yet stylish atmosphere with this classic.

2671059.name: Guest on a Moonlit Night Large Window
2671059.desc: Who... who are you? There are no guests coming tonight... If you're human, answer me, if you're a ghost, go away!

2671060.name: Spider Web Metal Window
2671060.desc: White spiderwebs and rusty iron frames create a creepy vibe. With a little bit of imagination, you can turn this house into a vampire's mansion, just as it must have looked hundreds of years ago!

2671061.name: [Poster] Phantom and Pumpkin City
2671061.desc: Nothing brightens up a house like a fun poster of something you enjoy.

2672079.name: Halloween Party Chair
2672079.desc: There are adorable ghosts and pumpkin decorations.

2672081.desc: On Halloween night, various guests come to visit. No need to stress out. Just hang up their coats and give them a cup of hot tea. Then, you'll all have a great time.

2672082.name: Witch's Iron Pot Fireplace
2672082.desc: *Boiling*, what is boiling in the iron pot? Wait, could it be...? No way!

2672083.desc: An old vampire's coffin is great for sitting, but be careful not to fall asleep!

2672084.name: Skull Chocolate Fountain
2672084.desc: It's richer and creamier since it is made by melting 99% cacao dark chocolate.

2672085.name: Gothic Iron Partition
2672085.desc: Be careful not to get stabbed!

2672086.name: Halloween Candy Tree
2672086.desc: Just seeing all the candies hanging from the tree makes you feel full. It's the abundance of the harvest season.

2672087.name: Jack-O-Lantern Totem Floor Lamp
2672087.desc: Colorful fluorescent lights illuminate your daily home life in a variety of ways.

2672088.name: Plum Nependeath of Hell
2672088.desc: Those who drank the Nependeath juice have all said that it was 'very delicious'. I wouldn't want to find out myself.

2672089.name: Light Green Nependeath of Hell
2672089.desc: Is it not fully ripe yet? Or did it turn green because it is scared of the high skies of Orbis?

2672090.name: Marigolds
2672090.desc: These colorful and beautiful marigolds connect this world to the afterlife.

2670113.name: Brown Gable Roof With Snow
2670113.desc: Throw yourself into the coziness of the soft snow. It will wrap you up, quietly and warmly, through the night.

2670114.name: Green Gable Roof With Snow
2670114.desc: When winter passes and the snow melts, you'll see the first greenery of spring.

2670115.name: Orange Gable Roof With Snow
2670115.desc: The white snow on this sweet, orange roof is like powdered sugar.

2670117.name: Chocolate Roof
2670117.desc: Everyone around can smell this roof's sweet aroma. Don't let the reindeer eat it.

2670118.name: Biscuit Roof
2670118.desc: A breaded roof with soft marshmallows. Every small child's dream home.

2670119.name: Red Brick Chimney
2670119.desc: A house with fluffy love rising!

2670120.name: Santa Claus Chimney
2670120.desc: For welcoming a special guest you've waited for all year.

2670121.name: Gingerbread Man Chimney
2670121.desc: There's a rumor that the gingerbread man's favorite dessert is sweet candy cane that melts in your mouth. Wonder if that's true.

2670122.name: Wooden Plaster Exterior Wall
2670122.desc: Looks like chocolate syrup on cookie dough. Looks like. Don't eat it.

2670124.name: Red Wood Exterior Wall
2670124.desc: The red wooden wall goes well with white snow, and will warm your space right up.

2670125.name: Warm Wood Interior Wall
2670125.desc: Everyone's invited to the cabin in the woods.

2670126.name: Simple White Wallpaper
2670126.desc: White like a snowfield, but not cold like one.

2670127.name: Classic Molding Wallpaper
2670127.desc: Feels like Grandma made a sweet cream cake for you.

2670128.name: Wreath-decorated Brown Window
2670128.desc: You can feel the excitement of the holiday.

2670129.name: Wreath-decorated Green Window
2670129.desc: Twinkle, twinkle! It'll shine through the night with a fluttering heart.

2670130.name: Wreath-decorated Orange Window
2670130.desc: The wreath's round shape can represent eternity, and the bond with someone you love.

2670131.name: Ginger Cookie Cracker Window
2670131.desc: Who doesn't love cookies and crackers?

2670132.name: Chocolate Ginger Cookie Window
2670132.desc: Feels like a sweet breeze will come wafting in.

2670133.name: Ginger Cookie Biscuit Window
2670133.desc: Feels like the queen of cookie kingdom will greet you when you knock!

2670134.name: Wooden Floor
2670134.desc: The comforting smell of trees, grass, and earth will wrap your body after a tiring day.

2670135.name: Maplemas Carpeted Floor
2670135.desc: A carpet filled with holiday memories. The carpet will remember today that was ordinary, but happy.

2670136.name: Fluffy Sheep Wool Carpeted Floor
2670136.desc: The fluffy, soft wool will make your life even cozier.

2671117.name: Maplemas Reindeer Ornament on Brick Pillar
2671117.desc: A brick pillar ornament with a reindeer. Goes great with fireplaces.

2671118.name: Maplemas Wreath Ornament on Stone Pillar
2671118.desc: A stone pillar ornament, refreshing like the sight of pristine snow. The Maplemas wreath stands out.

2671119.name: Maplemas Chandelier
2671119.desc: The warm light shines on all, like a holiday blessing.

2671120.name: Maplemas Ornament Shelf
2671120.desc: The colorful dishes are actually decorations. They CAN be used for serving food, but Amy might get mad.

2671121.name: Snow Twinkle Window
2671121.desc: Look at the beautiful stars snowflakes! It's hard to open, but that's okay, because it's cold outside anyway.

2671122.name: Maplemas Tree Garland
2671122.desc: Simply hanging it on the wall will brighten your holiday.

2671123.name: Maplemas Friends
2671123.desc: Thanks to Grandma Dona's very skilled hands, your Maplemas friends now have their own beautiful Maplemas wool ornaments!

2671124.name: Merry Maplemas Poster
2671124.desc: A poster filled with past holiday memories. Can you guess how many years ago it was?

2671125.name: Cozy Winter Poster
2671125.desc: A poster filled with past holiday memories. Can you guess how many years ago it was?

2671126.name: Maplemas Winter Camp Poster
2671126.desc: A poster filled with past holiday memories. Can you guess how many years ago it was?

2671127.name: Happyville Poster
2671127.desc: A poster filled with past holiday memories. Can you guess how many years ago it was?

2671128.name: Merry Mapledays Poster
2671128.desc: A poster filled with past holiday memories. Can you guess how many years ago it was?

2672151.name: Red Berry Pine Twig Fireplace
2672151.desc: Just looking at it makes you feel warmer. Cold as it might get out there, you can always keep warm inside with one of these.

2672152.name: Checkered Rocker
2672152.desc: This comfortable rocker will make you feel sleepy the moment you sit down. The red checkered cushion is Grandma Dona's work.

2672154.name: Maplemas Candle Table
2672154.desc: The flickering candlelight gives warmth. Who are all the presents for?

2672155.name: Hot Chocolate Cart
2672155.desc: Full of warm, sweet treats! Remember, even on Maplemas, don't go overboard, or your tummy will regret it!

2672156.name: Maplemas Dinner Table
2672156.desc: Most tables only fill up like this once or twice a year. Just looking at it makes you feel the party atmosphere.

2672157.name: Dinner Table Chair
2672157.desc: Anyone's welcome to sit here! Join the party, and share the joy!

2672158.name: Baking Table
2672158.desc: A party is the perfect chance to show off your culinary skills. The sweets' aroma stimulates the nose.

2672159.name: Waiting for Santa Bed
2672159.desc: Sleep in a bed like this, and Santa will definitely visit your house, even if you've been naughty.

2672160.name: Antique Phonograph
2672160.desc: You can almost hear old-timey music playing whenever you look at it. Grandma Dona grew up with that music, so of course she loves it, but it turns out Amy and Alvin love it too.

2672161.name: Querencia's Winter Snow Globe
2672161.desc: For the Querencia inside this beautiful snow globe, it's Maplemas all year long.

2672162.name: Maplemas Donation Kettle
2672162.desc: When you share your love and good will with your neighbors, everyone's holidays grow more abundant. You've also heard rumors that the highest donors will win special prizes!

2672163.name: Potted Poinsettia
2672163.desc: The red color goes well with the winter mood.

2672164.name: Maplemas Wooden Doll (Reindeer)
2672164.desc: It's been a long time since Kenneth showed off his skills. Doesn't it look familiar?

2672165.name: Maplemas Wooden Doll (Snowman)
2672165.desc: It's been a long time since Kenneth showed off his skills. Doesn't it look familiar?

2672166.name: Maplemas Wooden Doll (Santa)
2672166.desc: It's been a long time since Kenneth showed off his skills. Doesn't it look familiar?

2671129.name: Gifts and Gatherings Poster
2671129.desc: A poster filled with past holiday memories. Can you guess how many years ago it was?

2671130.name: Reindeer Garland
2671130.desc: Every time you look at it, you can't help but smile. It will make your holiday a little cozier.

2671131.name: Monster Garland
2671131.desc: Brings a cheerful laugh to your face every time you look at it. It will make your holiday a little merrier.

2632751.name: Sweet Hot Cocoa
2632751.desc: Curl up with this nice cup and spend the cold winter in warmth and leisure.

2632752.name: Hot Fruit Juice
2632752.desc: Curl up with this nice cup and spend the cold winter in warmth and leisure.

2672167.name: Elaborate Maplemas Tree
2672167.desc: Rudi loves this Maplemas tree. There are rumors that it won last year's decoration contest. If you share the pile of presents with your neighbors, your Maplemas will be that much more abundant!

2672186.desc: It's a mysterious orb made by Goblins to peer into their future. What was the future they were trying to see through this orb?

2672187.name: Goblin Special Hardwood Countertop
2672187.desc: It's a sloppy but well-equipped countertop, which is a good representation of what their food culture was like. The quest for cuisine is crucial for any tribe!

2691077.name: Chocolate

2691078.name: Leather Saddle
2691078.desc: A saddle that can be placed on the back of a stunned jungle boar. You can use it by double-clicking.

2691079.name: Smilodon Capture Cage
2691079.desc: A sturdy cage that can trap a stunned Smilodon. Smilodon is feared by all monsters in the jungle, so this should be quite useful.

2691080.name: Fireworks
2691080.desc:
Fireworks that produce a small display. Use to increase Attack Power and Defense while feeling festive. The resulting explosive sound when used can temporarily stun nearby monsters.

#c- Attack Power: +{attackPower:g}
- Defense: {defensePower:g}%
- Duration: {time:g}sec

2691081.name: Dish with Subtle Taste

2691082.name: Dish with Disappointing Taste

2691083.name: Frag Grenade
2691083.desc: A grenade made by processing gunpowder through alchemy. It can be used on enemies to inflict damage.

2691084.name: Firebomb
2691084.desc: A firebomb made by processing Lava Stone through alchemy. It can be used on enemies to inflict damage.

2691085.name: Smoke Bomb
2691085.desc: A smoke bomb made by processing charcoal through alchemy. It temporarily blurs the enemy's peripheral vision.

2691086.name: Flash-Bang
2691086.desc: A flash-bang made by refining Red Flower Powder through alchemy. It temporarily disables the enemy's vision.

2691087.name: Smoked Meat

2691088.name: Smoked Fish

2691089.name: Boiled Pork

2691090.name: Seafood Soup

2691091.name: Chun Gwon

2691092.name: Pad Thai

2691093.name: Expedition Diary
2691093.desc: A diary to document your travels on the Misty Island.\n#cDouble-click# the item to record the places you visit.

2691094.name: Masterpiece! Steak

2691095.name: Mysterious Cook Book
2691095.desc: A book that contains mysterious recipes.\n#cDouble-click# the item to see what dishes are recorded in the book.

2691096.name: Unreliable Clue
2691096.desc: A document that is presumed to contain a clue about the relic hidden on the Misty Island.\n#cDouble-click# the item to check the clue.

2691097.name: Matches
2691097.desc: It is a portable light source tool. You can be active at night, but your range of vision is short.

2691098.name: Torch
2691098.desc: It is a portable light source tool. With a moderate range of vision, you can be active even at night.

2691099.name: Return Scroll - Misty Island Ancient Ruins
2691099.desc: A scroll that allows you to return to the center of the ancient ruins by using the magical power of Lava Stone. Can be used any number of times.

2692000.name: Survival Worktable
2692000.desc: You can't survive in this dangerous wilderness with just your bare hands. Build a worktable to craft various tools and structures necessary for survival, and inform the headquarters that you have settled safely.

2692001.name: Industrial Worktable
2692001.desc: A worktable that can produce more practical and improved tools and structures, and can send and receive voice signals to and from the headquarters. #cWhen crafted, the Survival Worktable placed on the map is upgraded.

2692002.name: Engineering Worktable
2692002.desc: Lava Stone can be processed and used as an energy source, and allows for advanced mechanical devices to be crafted. A walkie-talkie with high reception sensitivity is attached. #cWhen crafted, the Industrial Worktable placed on the map is upgraded.

2692003.name: Alchemy Pot
2692003.desc: You can craft various recovery and enhancement medicines and poisons. Be careful not to confuse potions with poisons.

2692004.name: Enchantment Table
2692004.desc: You can craft equipment and defense facilities that contain powerful magic.

2692005.name: Bonfire
2692005.desc: You can light a fire to drive away the cold and darkness of the night and warm up a meal.

2692006.name: Improved Bonfire
2692006.desc: A brighter and longer-lasting bonfire using charcoal. You can drive away the cold and darkness of the night and grill up a hot meal.

2692007.name: Countertop
2692007.desc: You can prepare various ingredients to cook a wholesome meal. The results will be tastier than raw or grilled food, and have a good recovery effect, but...

2692008.name: Streetlight
2692008.desc: A streetlight that shines as brightly as the sun even at night.

2692009.name: Wooden Box
2692009.desc: A wooden box that can hold up to 8 items.

2692010.name: Improved Wooden Box
2692010.desc: A practical wooden box that can hold up to 12 items.

2692011.name: Palm Tent
2692011.desc: A tent made by weaving together large leaves. Blocks rain and wind and slightly recovers Acting Power.

2692012.name: Feather Tent
2692012.desc: A tent made of feathers and leather. Neophron feathers that adjust the temperature based on the external environment are placed on the roof to maintain the proper temperature at all times. It protects against wind and rain and heat, and recovers Acting Power.

2692013.name: Barricade
2692013.desc: A wooden barricade that protects against invading monsters. Sharpened points inflict low damage to monsters that touch the barricade.

2692014.name: Advanced Stone Wall
2692014.desc: A stone wall that firmly defends against invading monsters. It does not break easily.

2692015.name: Sturdy Advanced Stone Wall
2692015.desc: A stone wall made stronger by pouring concrete between the stones. It can firmly defend against invading monsters invasion and does not break easily.

2692016.name: Sticky Platform
2692016.desc: The stickiness of the platform significantly slows down monsters' Speed.

2692017.name: Monster Sound Speaker
2692017.desc: A speaker that produces a terrifying sound, even to monsters. Monsters take a small amount of damage and their Attack Power is decreased in fear upon hearing the sound.\n #cOnly 2 can be installed at a time.#

2692018.name: Molar Trap
2692018.desc: Inflicts low damage to passing monsters. Linking several molar traps together might be enough to kill the monsters.

2692019.name: Cannon Tower
2692019.desc: When a monster comes within range, it fires a cannon and inflicts a powerful attack.

2692020.name: Fireball Tower
2692020.desc: A fireball tower made from the hot flames found all around the island. Inflicts powerful damage on monsters.

2692021.name: Lightning Tower
2692021.desc: A lightning tower containing the mysterious power of the Thunder Stone. Inflicts damage on monsters with the power of lightning that rips through the sky, making them unable to move intermittently.

2692022.name: Water Bomb Tower
2692022.desc: Throws a water bomb containing the energy of the cold deep sea that freezes anything to its core. Inflicts damage on monsters and slows their Speed.

2692023.name: Automatic Fishing Rod
2692023.desc: An automatic fishing rod specially designed to catch fish anywhere. Once installed, it automatically catches fresh fish at regular intervals.

2692024.name: Holy Grail
2692024.desc: A holy grail made of pure gold imbued with magic containing the power of earth, water, and lightning. You will experience a miracle every time you drink from it.

2692025.name: Weather Controller
2692025.desc: With the power of magic, you can temporarily control the weather. The odds of success are not high.

2692026.name: Excavator
2692026.desc: A machine with a large claw that can excavate relics buried deep in the ground.

2692027.name: Relic Detector
2692027.desc: A device that can detect the power of Lava Stone contained inside relics. It takes a lot of time to find the exact location.

2692028.name: Wooden Fence
2692028.desc: A wooden fence made by tying together logs with rope. You can protect yourself from enemies until it is destroyed.

2692029.name: Wooden Barricade
2692029.desc: A wooden barricade made of wide-cut trees. By sharpening the tip, it inflicts damage to approaching enemies.

2692030.name: Stone Wall
2692030.desc: A stone wall made by mixing stone and steel materials. It looks very sturdy.

2692031.name: Advanced Stone Wall
2692031.desc: A wall made by applying fine-grained cement between stones. The dense structure makes it easy to block enemy attacks.

2692032.name: Enhanced Wall
2692032.desc: A wall made by combining stone, steel, and gold. Due to its high durability, it is suitable for defending against enemies.

2692033.name: Steel Thorn Wall
2692033.desc: A wall made of steel thorns that will sting from even the lightest touch. It inflicts strong damage to enemies that touch the wall before it is destroyed.

2692034.name: Lava Wall
2692034.desc: A wall that contains the energy of lava from a volcano located in the center of Misty Island. It inflicts powerful damage while blocking the enemy's approach.

2692035.name: Lava Stone Wall
2692035.desc: A wall that contains the magic of Lava Stone. It emits a red light, creating a powerful defense. It is stronger than any other wall and has the best durability.

2692036.name: Crossbow Tower
2692036.desc: A tower that fires crossbow arrows. You can fire at a rapid rate.

2692037.name: Cannon Tower
2692037.desc: A cannon tower made by mixing stone and steel. It fires shells at approaching enemies.

2692038.name: Mortar Tower
2692038.desc: A tower where huge mortars are fired. Due to its large size, its speed is slow, but it can inflict strong damage to a wide area.

2692039.name: Improved Cannon Tower
2692039.desc: A cannon tower with improved performance. It fires shells at approaching enemies, and stop their actions for a while.

2692040.name: Enhanced Crossbow Tower
2692040.desc: A crossbow tower with improved performance, enabling stronger attacks.

2692041.name: Fireball Tower
2692041.desc: A tower made with the energy of flame extracted from Lava Stone. It punishes approaching enemies with the power of a strong fire attribute.

2692042.name: Lightning Tower
2692042.desc: A tower that is modeled after the thunderstorms around the Misty Island. It inflicts lightning attribute attacks on approaching enemies, and at the same time stuns them with thunder for a while.

2692043.name: Frozen Tower
2692043.desc: A tower made with the biting cold energy from the depths of the sea where no one can touch. It inflicts ice attribute attacks on approaching enemies and slows their actions at the same time.

2692044.name: Magma Tower
2692044.desc: A tower with the magical power of Refined Lava Stone. Although it is slow, it emits a powerful force that scorches the earth. The speed of enemies who step on the ground engulfed in magma will be reduced and they will take continuous damage.

2692045.name: Magic Bullet Tower
2692045.desc: A tower with the magical power of Refined Lava Stone. It inflicts damage to multiple approaching enemies.

2692046.name: Campfire for cooking
2692046.desc: A bonfire for cooking that is made by building a brazier over a flame. With this, you can drive away the cold and darkness of the night, and cook a warm meal.

2692047.name: Animal Skin Tent
2692047.desc: A tent made of durable leather. It is optimized to withstand the external environment with the addition of a solid iron plate and processed wood. It blocks rain, wind, heat, and restores Acting Power more quickly.

2692048.name: Rainwater Filter
2692048.desc: A device that filters rainwater to be collected.

2692049.name: Well
2692049.desc: A well built to pump underground water. Water can be obtained from the well at regular intervals.

2692050.name: Sturdy Box
2692050.desc: A sturdy wooden box that can hold up to 16 items.

2692051.name: Magic Analysis Device
2692051.desc: Processes Lava Stone more precisely to be used as an energy source and a high quality crafting material. #cAfter installation, you can craft rare materials at the enchantment table.

2693000.name: Leaf
2693000.desc: A large and jagged leaf that is easily found in the jungle.

2693001.name: Log
2693001.desc: A log cut in half. It is easy to process, so it's suitable for making simple tools.

2693002.name: Stone
2693002.desc: A stone mined from rock. It is harder than wood and does not burn, so it can be used for everything from simple tools to construction equipment.

2693003.name: Iron
2693003.desc: A strong and durable material. It can be used to create various enhanced tools and complex items.

2693004.name: Gold
2693004.desc: A rare ore. It contains magical power.

2693005.name: Lava Stone
2693005.desc: A flaming red ore. It radiates powerful energy.

2693006.name: Feather
2693006.desc: A small and light feather that can be obtained from Toco Toucan.

2693008.name: Piranha Deadly Poison
2693008.desc: A terrifyingly deadly poison that paralyzes anything that comes into contact with it.

2693009.name: Jungle Pig Molar
2693009.desc: A hard and sharp molar from a jungle pig.

2693010.name: Lizardman Skin
2693010.desc: A tough hide from a Lizardman. It does not tear easily.

2693011.name: Golem Rubble
2693011.desc: The rubble from the Guardian Golems. Flames spark from it when provided with heat.

2693012.name: Neophron Feather
2693012.desc: A holy feather of Neophron. It adjusts the temperature according to its surroundings, and is water-resistant.

2693013.name: Smilodon Leather
2693013.desc: A blue leather of Smilodon. It is soft, but very tough and sturdy.

2693014.name: Smilodon Canine
2693014.desc: A canine from a Smilodon. It is extremely sharp, and hard as steel.

2693015.name: Lava Stone Powder
2693015.desc: Powdered Lava Stone that emits energy.

2693016.name: Fainted Jungle Pig
2693016.desc: A Jungle Pig that passed out from a critical wound. You can put on a Leather Saddle to ride on it.

2693017.name: Rope
2693017.desc: A multi-purpose rope made by twisting and weaving leaves. It is much more durable than it looks, which makes it good for tying things together.

2693018.name: Board
2693018.desc: A wooden board that is flat and sturdy. It can be used to make boxes or various structures.

2693019.name: Charcoal
2693019.desc: Charcoal made from burning wood. It can be used to make gunpowder or improved bonfire.

2693020.name: Brick
2693020.desc: Bricks made by processing stones. It is commonly used in building structures such as stone walls.

2693021.name: Iron Plate
2693021.desc: A thick, sturdy plate made of iron. It is used in various structures that require sturdiness.

2693022.name: Iron Rod
2693022.desc: A long rod made from iron. It is useful for creating sturdy tools.

2693023.name: Gold Bar
2693023.desc: A bar of refined gold with enhanced purity. It contains powerful magic.

2693024.name: Cement Powder
2693024.desc: Powder made from stones. It hardens when mixed with water.

2693025.name: Screw
2693025.desc: A screw for binding iron plates.

2693026.name: Cog
2693026.desc: A cog made from iron. It allows an efficient transmission of power.

2693027.name: Lever
2693027.desc: A lever to control the energy supply of the Lava Stone.

2693028.name: Propeller
2693028.desc: A propeller with four blades. It converts power from the engine to create a propulsive force.

2693029.name: Engine
2693029.desc: You can power it using the energy from the Lava Stone.

2693030.name: Gunpowder
2693030.desc: Gunpowder made from mixing charcoal and golem rubble. It explodes when exposed to heat.

2693031.name: Red Flower Powder
2693031.desc: Powder made from red flowers grown with the energy of Lava Stone. It can revitalize a fatigued body.

2693032.name: Banana Powder
2693032.desc: Powder made from condensed banana. It is nutritious and filling.

2693033.name: Herbal Powder
2693033.desc: Powder made from herbs. It is good for vitality, and helps the blood flow.

2693034.name: Empty Bucket
2693034.desc: A bucket made of iron. Press #cHarvest Key# near a waterfall to fill it with water. #cConsumes {consumeStamina:g} Acting Power#

2693036.name: Deep Sea Stone
2693036.desc: A stone that glows dark blue. It contains the energy of the deep, blue sea.

2693037.name: Thunder Stone
2693037.desc: A stone that gleams blue. It contains the pure energy of countless lightning strikes.

2693038.name: Jewel of Water
2693038.desc: A jewel that contains the energy of calm water. It is useful for making magical items.

2693039.name: Jewel of Lightning
2693039.desc: A jewel that contains the energy of powerful lightning. It is useful for making magical items.

2693040.name: Lava Solution
2693040.desc: A solution made by refining Lava Stone Powder. It can be used for making various potions.

2693041.name: Regeneration Solution
2693041.desc: A solution made by refining Red Flower Powder. It can be used for making special potions.

2693042.name: Fainted Smilodon
2693042.desc: A Smilodon that passed out from a critical wound.

2693043.name: Safety Charm
2693043.desc: A safety charm that may save you in a crucial moment.

2693044.name: Excavated Relic
2693044.desc: A relic you finally discovered after a tough expedition. You should keep it safe and return to headquarters.

2693045.name: 發掘的遺物
2693045.desc: 千辛萬苦之下獲取得遺物，好好保存並交回探險隊本部吧！

2693046.name: 發掘的遺物
2693046.desc: 千辛萬苦之下獲取得遺物，好好保存並交回探險隊本部吧！

2693047.name: 發掘的遺物
2693047.desc: 千辛萬苦之下獲取得遺物，好好保存並交回探險隊本部吧！

2693048.name: 發掘的遺物
2693048.desc: 千辛萬苦之下獲取得遺物，好好保存並交回探險隊本部吧！

2693049.name: 發掘的遺物
2693049.desc: 千辛萬苦之下獲取得遺物，好好保存並交回探險隊本部吧！

2693050.name: 發掘的遺物
2693050.desc: 千辛萬苦之下獲取得遺物，好好保存並交回探險隊本部吧！

2693051.name: 發掘的遺物
2693051.desc: 千辛萬苦之下獲取得遺物，好好保存並交回探險隊本部吧！

2693052.name: 發掘的遺物
2693052.desc: 千辛萬苦之下獲取得遺物，好好保存並交回探險隊本部吧！

2693053.name: 發掘的遺物
2693053.desc: 千辛萬苦之下獲取得遺物，好好保存並交回探險隊本部吧！

2693054.name: 發掘的遺物
2693054.desc: 千辛萬苦之下獲取得遺物，好好保存並交回探險隊本部吧！

2693056.name: Refined Lava Stone Crystal
2693056.desc: A crystal made by refining Lava Stone. It can be used to make special structures and equipment.

2693057.name: Processed Glued Laminated Wood
2693057.desc: Wood that has been cut into smaller pieces and glued together. Mostly used for building sturdy structures.

2693058.name: Captain's Cape
2693058.desc: It is presumed to be a cape worn by a certain captain long ago. It's too old to be worn anymore.

2693059.name: Wild Beast's Resentment
2693059.desc: It is presumed to be a necklace containing the resentment of a wild beast. It looks like it could be used to run an excavation machine.

2693060.name: Treasure Detector
2693060.desc: It is presumed to be a detector that a monkey hid in a backpack. It might come in handy when searching for a sunken ship buried under the beach.

2671113.name: Bird Cage
2671113.desc: It's not well-crafted, but you can sense the owner's love for birds. It's not used for food storage, is it?

2671115.name: Horn Chandelier
2671115.desc: Ancient goblins have always been inspired by nature. Each one is unique.

2672140.name: Smilodon Stone Bed
2672140.desc: Ancient goblins considered Smilodon to be a guardian animal and deified it. A hard bed modeled after a Smilodon will protect you throughout the dark night.

2672141.name: Goblin Throne
2672141.desc: The high back and fearsome horns must have been symbols of authority! If you want to exude wild charm and relentless dignity, this throne is for you.

2672142.name: Lizard Table
2672142.desc: It is clear that goblins and lizardmen have not been on good terms since ancient times. You can see that four dwarf lizardmen are holding up the table.

2672143.name: Goblin Chime
2672143.desc: It's...an instrument... That's for sure. It seems like the owner's taste in music was a little peculiar.

2672144.name: Palm Leaf Fan
2672144.desc: You can feel a natural breeze blowing! The ancient goblins must have crafted magic appliances using Lava Stones that enriched everyday life.

2672145.name: Triple Layer Safe
2672145.desc: Ancient goblins used this to store precious Lava Stones. It is the strongest safe in the world.

2672146.name: Neophron Statue
2672146.desc: Neophron was revered as the guardian of ancient goblins. This is the pinnacle of goblin art.

2672148.name: Full Moon Swing Chair
2672148.desc: Let's sit on the round moon and make a wish.

2672149.name: Bunny Doll Mood Lamp
2672149.desc: It is a cute bunny doll mood lamp. Its lights can be turned on/off by clicking it.

2672150.name: Eastern Earthenware Fountain
2672150.desc: Enjoy the water springing from deep in the mountains.

2634207.name: Green Gable Roof With Snow Set
2634207.desc:
#cDouble-click# to receive all of the following blueprints:#c
 - Gable Roof With Snow (Green)
 - Mix-And-Match Exterior Wall
 - Wreath-decorated Window (Green)

2634208.name: Maplemas Cracker Hut Set
2634208.desc: #cDouble-click# to receive all of the following blueprints:#c\n - Cracker Roof\n - Gingerbread Window (Cracker)

2634209.name: Orange Gable Roof With Snow Set
2634209.desc:
#cDouble-click# to receive all of the following blueprints:#c
 - Gable Roof With Snow (Orange)
 - Red Wood Exterior Wall
 - Wreath-decorated Window (Orange)

2634210.name: Maplemas Santa Claus Hut Set
2634210.desc:
#cDouble-click# to receive all of the following blueprints:#c
 - Maplemas Carpeted Floor
 - Santa Claus Chimney
 - Simple White Wallpaper

2634211.name: Maplemas Choco Hut Set
2634211.desc: #cDouble-click# to receive all of the following blueprints:#c\n - Chocolate Roof\n - Gingerbread Window (Choco)

2634212.name: Maplemas Biscuit Hut Set
2634212.desc: #cDouble-click# to receive all of the following blueprints:#c\n - Biscuit Roof\n - Gingerbread Window (Biscuit)

2634213.name: Maplemas Gingerbread Man Hut Set
2634213.desc:
#cDouble-click# to receive all of the following blueprints:#c
 - Fluffy Sheep Wool Carpeted Floor
 - Gingerbread Man Chimney
 - Classic Molding Wallpaper

2635497.name: Permanent Fluffy Rabbit Mount Coupon
2635497.desc: Show off this charming little critter in Henesys.\r\n#cDouble-click# to permanently gain the Fluffy Rabbit mount skill with High Altitude Flight.

2634437.name: Symbol Selector Coupon
2634437.desc: Double-click to select and obtain one of the following items:
2634437.desc_leftalign: #c\n- Arcane Symbol Selector Coupon x4\n- Sacred Symbol Selector Coupon x1

2634438.name: Special Symbol Selector Coupon
2634438.desc: Double-click to select and obtain one of the following items:
2634438.desc_leftalign: #c\n- Arcane Symbol Selector Coupon x10\n- Sacred Symbol Selector Coupon x3

2634439.desc: #cDouble-click# to obtain a #cRoyal Hair Coupon (3 Days).
2634439.name: Royal Hair Coupon Voucher

2634440.desc: #cDouble-click# to obtain a #cRoyal Face Coupon (3 Days).
2634440.name: Royal Face Coupon Voucher

2631997.name: [Maple Expedition] Basic Settlement Support Box
2631997.desc: A box containing logs. Before exploring an unknown place, you can create a basic tool or structure to settle down safely and quickly.

2631998.name: [Maple Expedition] Intermediate Settlement Support Box
2631998.desc: A box containing logs and stones. Before exploring an unknown place, you can create a basic tool or structure to settle down safely and quickly.

2631999.name: [Maple Expedition] Advanced Settlement Support Box
2631999.desc: A box containing logs, stones, and iron. Before exploring an unknown place, you can create a basic tool or structure to settle down safely and quickly.

2632000.name: [Maple Expedition] Emergency Food Pouch
2632000.desc: Contains a High Calorie Energy Bar and Chocolate. They have a long shelf life, so they are suitable as emergency food.

2632001.name: [Maple Expedition] Stuffed Emergency Food Pouch
2632001.desc: Contains Hardtack and Chocolate. They have a long shelf life and are very filling, so they are suitable as emergency food.

2632002.name: [Maple Expedition] Long Lasting Emergency Food Pouch
2632002.desc: Contains Canned Food and Chocolate. They have a long shelf life, so they are suitable as emergency food.

2632003.name: [Maple Expedition] First Aid Kit
2632003.desc: Contains a Recovery Potion that can be used in an emergency.

2632004.name: [Maple Expedition] Nutritional Supplement Kit
2632004.desc: Contains a Buff Potion that can be used strategically.

2632005.name: [Maple Expedition] Expedition Harvesting Equipment Box
2632005.desc: Contains a highly durable Stone Axe and a Stone Hoe that Expedition Headquarters made after extensive research.

2632006.desc: Contains a highly durable weapon that Expedition Headquarters made after extensive research.
2632006.name: [Maple Expedition] Expedition Combat Equipment Box

2632110.desc: A relic found in the Island of Mirages. #cDouble-click# to exchange it for #cExpedition Points# or #cHome Furnishing#.
2632110.name: Excavated Relic

2635107.name: Epic Frozen Set Box
2635107.desc:
#cDouble-click# to get an Epic rank Frozen Set.#c

Frozen Weapon for your job
Frozen Secondary Weapon for your job
Frozen Hat
Frozen Outfit
Frozen Cape#

2024129.name: Overwhelming Power Drink
2024129.desc: Drink this for a taste of greatness. #cAttack Power and Magic ATT +30 and Defense +30 for 30 minutes.#\r\n #cAwaken the power inside you!#

2028406.name: Neo Tokyo Familiar Card Pack
2028406.desc:
#cDouble-click# to get one Neo Tokyo Familiar Card.

#cCards up to Rare rank can appear.
Each card has a set probability rate.#

2070029.name: Magic Throwing Knife
2070029.desc: A throwing knife made from unknown extraterrestrial energy.\r\nAttack Power +30

2330020.name: Armor-Piercing Bullets
2330020.desc: These armor-piercing bullets can pierce the machines' special armor. They're imbued with special energy from space. The bullets' outer brass is decorated.\r\nAttack Power +22

2634823.name: Permanent Nibelung Mount Coupon
2634823.desc: #cDouble-click# to get a permanent #cNibelung mount# that can #cdouble jump#.\r\n\r\n

2634772.name: Aufheben Damage Skin (Unit)
2634772.desc: #cDouble-click# to get the Aufheben Damage Skin (Unit).\r\n\r\n#cOnce used, it will remain applied until you replace it with another damage skin.#

2634917.name: Magic Throwing Knife Coupon
2634917.desc: #cDouble-click# to obtain the following #cuntradable# item.\r\n#c- Magic Throwing Knife#

2634918.name: Armor-Piercing Bullets Coupon
2634918.desc: #cDouble-click# to obtain the following #cuntradable# item.\r\n#c- Armor-Piercing Bullets#

2635081.name: Aufheben Damage Skin (Unit)
2635081.desc: #cDouble-click# to get the Aufheben Damage Skin (Unit).\r\n\r\n#cOnce used, it will remain applied until you replace it with another damage skin.#

2710028.name: Mystical Cube
2710028.desc: This Miracle Cube supposedly brings out the hidden potential in equipment, but it emits a mystical energy.\n#cCan only be used on items from Rare to Epic# \n#cMax Result: Epic#

2710029.name: Hard Cube

2000060.desc: Susan's specially made Guild Castle Cookie, just for you! Hurry up and eat it before Oliver does!\n#cUse to recover 5,000 HP/2,500 MP.#

2000061.name: Guild Castle Specialty Cocktail
2000061.desc: A sweet cocktail that elevates the ambiance of the Guild Castle. Take care not to get swept up by the mood and overindulge!\n#cUse to recover 2,500 HP/5,000 MP.#

2000062.name: Guild Castle Specialty Rations
2000062.desc: Rations with the perfect balance of necessary nutrients. They should be useful during long engagements. Make sure to grab a bunch before leaving the castle.\n#cUse to recover 7,500 HP/MP.#

2002102.name: Kiddie Potion
2002102.desc: Oliver, in his days as an aspiring alchemist, once called this his masterpiece. In theory, drinking it will make you cuter. In theory.

2024148.name: Energy Stone's Protection
2024148.desc: You feels more powerful with the Energy Stone's protection around you. Use for +30 ATT.\n\n#cEffect applied only in Greed Infested Cache.#

2024149.name: Energy Stone's Grace
2024149.desc: You feel more powerful with the Energy Stone's grace in your heart. Use for +30 Magic ATT.\n\n#cEffect applied only in Greed Infested Cache.#

2024150.name: Energy Stone's Blessing
2024150.desc: You feel more powerful with the Energy Stone's blessing in your heart. Use for +30% Damage Against Normal Monsters.\n\n#cEffect applied only in Greed Infested Cache.#

2030063.name: Guild Castle Specialty Return Scroll
2030063.desc: A scroll used to return to a nearby town. It's specially made in the Guild Castle, and has a high-quality feel to it.

2048780.name: Karma Powerful Rebirth Flame
2048780.desc: Use on an #cuntradable# equipment item to grant it bonus stats. The bonus stats are selected according to set probability rates, and have a chance of having higher values than are typical. If used on equipment that already has bonus stats, those bonus stats will be rerolled.\r\nHowever, #ctradable# equipment will become #cuntradable when equipped#.

2120014.name: Guild Castle Specialty Pet Snack
2120014.desc: A Pet Snack representing the Guild Castle's elegance. It recovers your pet's Fullness by 30.

2210262.name: Brown Hare Transformation Potion
2210262.desc: A potion that transforms you into a Brown Hare. Lasts for 10 minutes.\n#c*Warning: You can't use ladders or ropes while transformed.#

2210263.name: White Hare Transformation Potion
2210263.desc: A potion that transforms you into a White Hare. Lasts for 10 minutes.\n#c*Warning: You can't use ladders or ropes while transformed.#

2635541.name: Thunbergia Pot
2635541.desc: This elegant flower pot holds thunbergia erecta, a type of morning glory flower also known as the king's mantle. The elegant, old-world style of St. Tia is on full display. These flowers should help the Guild Castle welcome each glorious morning.

2635542.name: Bridal Wreath Pot
2635542.desc: An elegant flower pot with flowers pruned from the Greenhouse. The antique and elegant style of St. Tia is on full display.\nIt carries a soft, flowery scent.

2635543.name: Oberon's Vase
2635543.desc: This flower vase contains rare pansies from what was once called the Fairy Forest.\nRumor has it that rubbing the sap from the crushed petals around someone's eyes will make them fall in love with the first person they see.

2635544.name: Pot of Purity
2635544.desc: This pot of flowers represents our love for our shared home.\nAs long as that love holds strong, the flowers will not wilt.

2635545.name: Form of Power Statue
2635545.desc: An artistic, geometric statue representing the power of the Energy Stone.\nIt radiates awe and reverence.

2635546.name: Form of a Droplet Statue
2635546.desc: This sculpture's curved surface is meant to represent a falling droplet of water, which in turn represents the tears of one who dedicated themselves to the protection of the castle.

2635547.name: Ornate Decorative Sword
2635547.desc: This sword was clearly well cared for. It was forged a long time ago, but it still feels like it's fresh off the anvil.

2635548.name: Plaster Bust
2635548.desc: A plaster bust of a man who was well-known in St. Tia for his good looks. Makes any room feel more attractive. Nothing beats the classics!

2635549.name: Crystal Lighting Ornament
2635549.desc: This crystal decoration emits a soft glow.\nThe ore is unrefined, and has a mysterious quality to it.

2635550.name: Crystal Candelabrum
2635550.desc: A candelabrum with multiple candles dipped in gold placed on it.\nThe sparkling crystal decorations make it look like a glistening chandelier.

2635551.name: Pig Statue
2635551.desc: A stone statue in the shape of a common Maple World pig.\nRumors say that placing one in the Guild Castle increases luck when it comes to money.

2635552.name: Mushroom Statue
2635552.desc: A stone statue in the shape of a common Maple World Orange Mushroom.\nRumors say that placing one in the Guild Castle brings happiness.

2635553.name: Slime Statue
2635553.desc: A stone statue in the shape of a common Maple World slime.\nRumors say that the statue grants wishes.

2635554.name: Snail Statue
2635554.desc: A stone statue in the shape of a common Maple World snail.\nRumors say that placing one in the Guild Castle grants long life and long-term success.

2635555.name: Noble's Altar
2635555.desc: This altar stands in honor of the castle's past defenders and the sacrifices they made.\nA large censer sits in the center.

2635556.name: Oil Painting Easel
2635556.desc: An easel with an oil painting of a landscape, placed in a golden frame. If your mind is crowded with noisy thoughts, gaze at this painting. Peace will surely come to you.

2635557.name: Guild Castle Flag
2635557.desc: This flag goes with any room in the Guild Castle. The blue fabric and luxurious decorations show off the guild's high status.

2635558.name: White Grand Piano
2635558.desc: One of the castle's past residents favored this grand piano.\nIf you listen, you can almost hear the echoes of its old melodies.

2635559.name: Angel's Harp
2635559.desc: A statue of an angel playing the harp. Originally, this piece only included the harp, but an artist added the angel to represent comfort when laying down to sleep amidst crowded thoughts.

2635560.name: Goddess Minerva Statue
2635560.desc: While studying abroad in Orbis, a sculptor came across a statue of Minerva, and created this statue in tribute. According to the story, the sculptor also wanted to comfort someone who suffered from insomnia. Rumors say that those who pet the statue of Eliza, who's asleep at the goddess's feet, will fall into sleep free of nightmares.

2635561.name: Spirit of the Snow Statue
2635561.desc: A statue sculpted in the form of a Spirit of Snow. Created with pristine ice, it holds together without melting, thanks to the Energy Stone's protection.

2635562.name: Dragon Fossil
2635562.desc: The old kingdom's archaeologist worked long and hard to complete this skeletal structure. It was a great asset for biological research, and played a crucial role during the war against the dragons in the past.

2635563.name: Phonograph Cabinet and Sofa
2635563.desc: A comfortable fabric sofa, placed next to the Phonograph Cabinet.\nSit down, listen to music, and feel all your worries drift away.

2635564.name: Grandfather Clock
2635564.desc: This grandfather clock befits the elegant look of the castle.\nAs one of the castle's oldest decorations, it continued to tell the time even after the residents had left the castle behind.

2635565.name: St. Tia Fountain
2635565.desc: A large fountain with numerous decorations.\nBuilt in the style of St. Tia, it portrays the land's distinctive style.

2635566.name: Craftsman Statue
2635566.desc: When a certain kingdom defeated a plague of dragons, an artist spent the rest of his life sculpting a monument to the victory. This sculpture radiates pride in that victory, as well as a sense of solidarity with the hero facing the dragon.

2635567.name: Pipe Organ
2635567.desc: A massive instrument befitting an impressive castle like yours. If you sit down and start to play it, then deep, calm melodies will permeate throughout the castle.

2635568.name: Hero Statue
2635568.desc: When a certain kingdom defeated a plague of dragons, an artist spent the rest of his life sculpting a monument to the victory. This is a recreation of, and homage to, that original monument.

2635585.name: Heart goes pew pew!
2635585.desc: Express your feelings to someone else.\n\n#cCan only be used inside the Guild Castle.#

2635586.name: Boom-boom Fireworks
2635586.desc: Light these up to set off a celebration on a special day.\n\n#cCan only be used inside the Guild Castle.#

2635587.name: Scatter Pollen
2635587.desc: Flower petals flutter just like my heart...\n\n#cCan only be used inside the Guild Castle.#

2635588.name: Kiddie Potion
2635588.desc: Oliver, in his days as an aspiring alchemist, once called this his masterpiece. In theory, drinking it will make you cuter. In theory.

2635605.name: Maple Tree Lumber
2635605.desc:
#cGuild Castle Decoration Blueprint Material#
High-quality lumber from a maple tree. A necessary part of Guild Castle decoration crafting.
Obtained as a low-chance monster drop. Bring it to #cBenedict in the Guild Castle# to craft a decoration during a Guild Castle decoration blueprint event.
#cGuild Castle decoration materials disappear every Monday at 12:00 AM.#

2635606.name: Unknown Smithing Stone
2635606.desc:
#cGuild Castle Decoration Blueprint Material#
A mysterious smithing stone with unknown properties. A necessary part of Guild Castle decoration crafting.
Obtained as a low-chance monster drop. Bring it to #cBenedict in the Guild Castle# to craft a decoration during a Guild Castle decoration blueprint event.
#cGuild Castle decoration materials disappear every Monday at 12:00 AM.#

2635607.name: Blessing Powder
2635607.desc: #cGuild Castle Decoration Blueprint Material# A powder used to bless Guild Castle decorations. A necessary part of Guild Castle decoration crafting.\r\nObtained as a low-chance monster drop. Bring it to #cBenedict in the Guild Castle# to craft a decoration during a Guild Castle decoration blueprint event.\r\n#cGuild Castle decoration materials disappear every Monday at 12:00 AM.#

2635608.name: Breath of the Artisan
2635608.desc: #cGuild Castle Decoration Blueprint Material# The Breath of the Artisan is necessary to craft the Guild Castle's best decorations.\r\nThe Guild Leader can obtain 1 every week, through the Energy Stone, after clearing a Weekly Quest or as a low-chance boss monster drop. Bring it to #cBenedict in the Guild Castle# to craft a decoration, during a Guild Castle decoration blueprint event.\r\n#cGuild Castle decoration materials disappear at midnight of the last day of every month.#

2635712.name: Pew Pew Heart
2635712.desc: Stop holding in your feelings and express yourself.\n\n#cCan only be used inside the Guild Castle.#

2635720.name: Bittersweet Chocolate Cake
2635720.desc: An extra thick chocolate cake for all chocolate lovers out there! Even from across the room, you can smell how sweet it is.\n\n#c*Caution! All objects in the Party Room are reset after midnight.

2635721.name: Retro Cherry Cake
2635721.desc: It's almost too pretty to eat! A retro-style butter cake, topped off with plenty of fresh cherries. Make sure to eat one of the cherries before your guild members get them all!\n\n#c*Caution! All objects in the Party Room are reset after midnight.

2635722.name: Pearlescent Cream Cake
2635722.desc: Have a spoonful, and feel that cream melt in your mouth.\n\n#c*Caution! All objects in the Party Room are reset after midnight.

2635723.name: Triangle Garland
2635723.desc: A triangular garland with cute little patterns.\n\n#c*Caution! All objects in the Party Room are reset after midnight.

2635724.name: Fresh Flower Garland
2635724.desc: Breathe in that fresh flower scent! A garland woven with flowers from the Greenhouse.\n\n#c*Caution! All objects in the Party Room are reset after midnight.

2635725.name: Sparkle Fuzzy Garland
2635725.desc:
Oh no! A Rock Spirit was frozen solid!
'Yeti not frozen. Yeti strong against cold!'

#c*Caution! All objects in the Party Room are reset after midnight.

2635726.name: Star Slime Garland
2635726.desc:
A star for memories, a star for love, and a star for.... slime?
A heavenly decoration for slime lovers like you.

#c*Caution! All objects in the Party Room are reset after midnight.

2635727.name: Mystery Candle
2635727.desc:
Why not close your eyes and pick out a candle? What color do you think you'll get?

#c*A single yellow, orange, or blue candle will appear.
*Caution! All objects in the Party Room are reset after midnight.

2635728.name: Celebratory Candle
2635728.desc: If lighting only one candle won't do the trick, try this one!\n\n#c*Caution! All objects in the Party Room are reset after midnight.

2635729.name: Squirming Twisted Candle
2635729.desc: A twisting candle that looks like a whirlwind. Perfect for special occasions, or for when you just need a unique-looking candle.\n\n#c*Caution! All objects in the Party Room are reset after midnight.

2635730.name: Sun and Moon Love Candle
2635730.desc: They glow like stars you've plucked from the sky, for the person you care about most. Illuminate a dark room with your love.\n\n#c*Caution! All objects in the Party Room are reset after midnight.

2635731.name: Delightful Digits Candle
2635731.desc:
Looking to celebrate an anniversary with a special friend? To congratulate them on reaching a certain level? Then look no further! One of these candles will do the trick!

#c*You can use number candles ranging from 0 to 999.
*Caution! All objects in the Party Room are reset after midnight.

2635732.name: Pink Bean Hot-Air Balloon
2635732.desc:
An adorable Pink Bean Hot-Air Balloon that floats around!
It will give the Party Room a cuteness boost.

#c*Caution! All objects in the Party Room are reset after midnight.

2635733.name: Yeti Hot-Air Balloon
2635733.desc:
An adorable Yeti Hot-Air Balloon that floats around.
It will give the Party Room a cuteness boost.

#c*Caution! All objects in the Party Room are reset after midnight.

2635734.name: Plump Balloon Pouch
2635734.desc: A pouch with balloon bundles meant just for you!\n\n#c*Caution! All objects in the Party Room are reset after midnight.

2635735.name: Plentiful Balloon Pouch
2635735.desc:
A pouch full of balloon bundles meant just for you!
Open it up and fill up your Party Room!

#c*Caution! All objects in the Party Room are reset after midnight.

2636023.desc: A #cChapter I# Completion Box. Give yourself a pat on the shoulder for working hard on the daily and challenge missions.\n\n#cItems obtained from the box can be transferred within the same world.#

2636024.name: Chapter II Completion Box
2636024.desc: A #cChapter II# Completion Box. You feel stronger every day, and look forward to the journeys to come.\n\n#cItems obtained from the box can be transferred within the same world.#

2636025.name: Chapter III Completion Box
2636025.desc: A #cChapter III# Completion Box. You've already completed the third chapter. You're clearly good at this.\n\n#cItems obtained from the box can be transferred within the same world.#

2636026.name: Chapter IV Completion Box
2636026.desc: A #cChapter IV# Completion Box. You're more than halfway done with you journey. Will you be able to obtain the Sixth Star if you muster a little more strength?\n\n#cItems obtained from the box can be transferred within the same world.#

2636027.name: Chapter V Completion Box
2636027.desc: A #cChapter V# Completion Box. Only one more step to go. You can feel the energy of the sixth power is near.\n\n#cItems obtained from the box can be transferred within the same world.#

2636028.name: Chapter VI Completion Box
2636028.desc:
A #cChapter VI# Completion Box. You've finally complete the journey to the Sixth Star!

2677069.desc: A statue carved in the likeness of a knight chess piece, highly-sought after by first-time homeowners as a symbol of protection. It keeps a watchful eye on any visitors...though experienced burglars know that they can distract it with a nice marble carving of a carrot.

2677070.name: Tallahart-Style Brazier
2677070.desc: A Tallahart-style brazier that shines with the ancient city's unique charm.\nDon't get lost in its glow, or you'll be the one who gets burned.

2677071.name: Phantasmal Tree
2677071.desc: A Phantasmal Tree, sprouted from the glory and the ruin of Tallahart.\nYou need only place a hand upon its bark to see echoes of the ancient past.

2677080.name: Operation Ultima Hologram
2677080.desc: Crafted in the image of the forward operating base's command center, now you can relive the excitement of Operation Ultima from your very own base.

2677081.name: Magic Fireplace
2677081.desc: A fireplace befitting of Lethe's mansion. The magical flame burning in the heart warms the soul itself.

2677082.name: Antique Bed
2677082.desc: A bed befitting of Lethe's mansion. Enjoy resting in the lap of luxury.

2677083.name: Magical Safe
2677083.desc: A safe befitting of Lethe's mansion. Rest easy knowing your precious items are locked up safe as can be.\n\n#cPlace and click to access the Storage Room.

2676088.name: Overdrive Poster
2676088.desc: A glimmering poster celebrating the Overdrive update.

2677072.name: Dark Sea Model Temple
2677072.desc: A glass display that recreates the Temple of the Radiant Star. Legends tell of a shining goddess who dwells there, luring the sailors of the Dark Sea with her siren song...yet, the music always ends in screams. Click on the furniture to change the appearance of the temple.

2677073.name: Ellanos
2677073.desc: Ellanos, the mystical creature born of the phantasms of Tallahart, seems to have...grown used to indoor heating and regular meals? Ellanos seems perfectly content to lounge around now. Just make sure to sweep up its less-than-phantasmic fur.

2677075.name: Well-Loved Athena Pierce Doll
2677075.desc: An Athena Pierce doll that has been held so much the stuffing is bursting from the seams in several places. As worn as it is, the fabric is soft and comforting.

2677076.name: Mercedes Pillow
2677076.desc: A limited-edition pillow decorated with art of Mercedes, Ruler of the Elves. Only a few were ever made, so it's highly-prized among fans.

2677077.name: Giant Mushroom Garden Pool
2677077.desc: A glass bowl decorated to look like Seokchon Lake, including, for some reason, a reproduction of the monster summoning magic. The Giant Mushroom always shows up first and gets stuck, so even if it might flood the house a bit, there's no chance of a flood of monsters.

2677078.name: Teddy Bear
2677078.desc: The kindly old Magne of Cernium asked you to find this cute plush. Apparently, Magne's granddaughter loves it.

2677079.name: Scorched Scripture
2677079.desc: A common book of scripture from Cernium. While the library burned around it, reduced mostly to ash, this book itself is only lightly singed. Is that a real miracle?

2676026.desc:

 It's the product of the efforts of countless explorers, and gazing at it is enough to reignite your sense of adventure. Where to next?

2676027.name: NLM Yeti Wall Art
2676027.desc: A neon Yeti sign that took up a whole wall of the New Leaf Mall. If you stare at it for long enough, you start to get the feeling that you can one-shot that boss you were struggling with. You can change the color of the neon sign by touching it.
