2677031.desc_leftalign: #cOnly Limited Label or Jin Label items can be placed in it.#

2677032.name: Kaling Canopy Bed
2677032.desc: A canopy bed modeled after Kaling's style. You can't quite say why, but you feel as if sleeping here will transform you into an exhausted grad student. Could a grad student afford a canopy bed? Let's not ask hurtful questions.

2677033.name: Specter's Clutch Chair
2677033.desc: A chair in the shape of a giant Specter hand. It looks real enough to reach out and grab you, but that hasn't happened...yet.

2677034.name: Mini Sleipnir
2677034.desc: A wooden rocking horse modeled after Baldrix's Sleipnir. Don't repeat this, but someone said that Baldrix used to ride it as a child. Apparently, old habits die hard...

2677035.name: Weapon Mount
2677035.desc: A rack that holds legendary weapons used by some ancient warrior. When you touch it, a brilliant light shines forth. Ages may pass, but a truly noble spirit can endure.

2677036.name: Netherworld Display Case
2677036.desc: A display case modeled after some ancient warrior's forgotten battleground. You can use it to display items that remind you of your adventures.
2677036.desc_leftalign: #cPlace and click, then drag an item into a slot to display it.\n\nCan only place 1 of each type of display case.

2677037.name: Maple Desk Calendar
2677037.desc: A desk calendar with a drawing of a cute slime. Its cheerful, slimy face seems to urge you to treat every single day as a gift. Or at least to remember your appointments.

2677038.name: Nodestone Popcorn Maker
2677038.desc: Once you've used so many Nodestones that you've reached the very top, what should you do with them? Make them into popcorn, of course! Chowing down on a handful of these rock-hard kernels is the ultimate flex.

2677039.name: Nodestone Bean Bag
2677039.desc: The craftsman that used to make Nodestones has gotten a bit bored and started a side project. The result: this Nodestone-shaped bean bag! Before you rip the seams open, though, it's not full of Nodestones, just ordinary beans.

2677040.name: Experience Nodestone Bean Bag
2677040.desc: The craftsman that used to make Nodestones has gotten a bit bored and started a side project. The result: this Experience Nodestone-shaped bean bag! Before you rip the seams open, though, it's not full of Experience Nodestones, just ordinary beans.

2677041.name: Mirror World Nodestone Bean Bag
2677041.desc: After collecting all of Mirror World's Nodestones, you've finally gotten the ultimate collector's item: a bean bag shaped to look like them. Now everyone will know that you're the biggest Mirror World Nodestone fan there is.

2677042.name: Mitra's Nodestone Bean Bag
2677042.desc: After collecting all of Mitra's Nodestones, you've finally gotten the ultimate collector's item: a bean bag shaped to look like them. Now everyone will know that you're the biggest Mitra Nodestone fan there is.

2677043.name: Bright Treasure Chest
2677043.desc: An incredibly rare Legendary Diamond Treasure Box which shines with five colors and sparkles brilliantly. Sure to make all the other treasure hunters incredibly jealous.\n\n#cPlace and click to access the Storage Room.

2677044.name: Mini Circulator
2677044.desc: A small, white circulator. It was supposedly a made to be a souvenir for people who used circulators for Ability Reset...but isn't that pun a bit of a stretch? Don't count on it to cool down your room--it's not a fan.

2677045.name: Display Case
2677045.desc: A fancy display case to display your most precious items. You are putting your treasures in a literal spotlight, so be sure you get a good lock, too.
2677045.desc_leftalign: #cPlack and click, then drag an item into a slot to display it.\n\nCan only place 1 of each type of display case.

2677046.name: King Size Luxury Golden Bed
2677046.desc: A luxury golden bed for people who shine with the light of countless stars. It gives off a golden luster as majestic as its owner. You'll shine even brighter if you're with someone special.

2677047.name: Sleepywood Foot Bath
2677047.desc: A replica of the foot bath at the Sleepywood Hotel Sauna. It's a little piece of luxury that can come home with you when you have to leave the sauna. And, even better, it can be enjoyed with a friend.

2677052.name: Autumn Lights Display Case
2677052.desc: A kiosk that can display your favorite things with the scent of crisp autumn leaves. You can display items that aren't clothes or accessories, whether or not Camila approves.
